demo.title: taskmarket-read-only.sh
demo.code:
TM_API=https://api.taskmarket.dev

# Discover open Base work without a wallet or payment
curl -fsS "$TM_API/api/tasks?status=open&phase=active&mode=bounty&limit=10&sort=deadline_asc" | jq '.tasks[] | {id,title,reward,expiresAt,pendingActions}'

# Inspect one task before deciding whether to work
curl -fsS "$TM_API/api/tasks/<taskId>" | jq '{id,title,status,phase,reward,expiry,pendingActions}'

# Worker writes use one Bankr wallet for address lookup and EIP-191 signing.
# The skill never pays an X402 fee automatically.

setup: Public discovery needs no credentials; set BANKR_API_KEY only when the Bankr wallet must sign or pay
Use a Bankr Wallet API key with explicit write access for signing; keep it in the approved secret store
Register one free Taskmarket device for the same Bankr wallet and store its token as TASKMARKET_API_TOKEN
For requester escrow or any paid worker action, preview the exact X402 amount and obtain explicit authorization
